summary: Backpressure cascade from prefetch lock contention causing elevated 5xx error rate for dedicated tenant
description:
Issue summary:

During a sustained traffic ramp for a single dedicated tenant (NovaChat Inc.) we observed a correlated increase in 5xx responses originating at the API gateway and upstream runtime restarts. The signal appears tied to aggressive prefetch behavior on the serving runtime where prefetch lock contention leads to a backpressure cascade: queued requests block on prefetch locks, API gateway queue growth triggers hedged retries, and runtimes hit watchdog timeouts and restart.

Impact:
- ~18% elevated 5xx rate for the tenant across us-east over a 30 minute window (affecting production traffic).
- Streaming sessions experienced intermittent resets; short requests returned 502/503.
- Customer reports increased error rates and a temporary degradation of SLAs for some user flows.

Environment:
- Production (us-east), Dedicated pool assigned to NovaChat.
- Serving runtime version: 2026.02.11-rc3
- API gateway version: 2026.03.01

Observed behavior:
- Prefetch workers spike CPU and hold kvcache locks for longer than expected (seen in runtime metrics).
- API gateway accept queue depth climbs, then hedged retries increase outbound volume.
- Runtimes emit watchdog timeout and restart; following restarts, prefetched KV warms cause transient additional load and more contention.

Expected behavior:
- Prefetch should back off under contention, API gateway should apply backpressure without creating hedged retry amplification, and runtimes should avoid watchdog restarts by failing fast or shedding load.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use dedicated tenant with prefetch enabled and kvcache sharding (matching NovaChat config).
2) Ramp concurrent short text generation requests to ~4x normal baseline with a mix of streaming and non-streaming calls.
3) Observe prefetch worker CPU, kvcache lock wait times, and API gateway accept queue depth in prod metrics dashboards.
4) Watch for hedged retry growth and runtime watchdog restarts once queueing exceeds configured thresholds.
logs: 2026-03-12T21:03:12Z api-gw us-east accept_queue=132 hedged_retries=18 status=502 tenant=novachat
2026-03-12T21:05:20Z api-gw us-east accept_queue=10 hedged_retries=3 status=200 tenant=novachat
investigation_notes: Initial triage: alerting flagged a sudden spike in 5xx for tenant Novachat around 21:00 UTC. Pagerduty routed to SRE on-call.
Metric correlation: high prefetch_lock_wait_ms correlated tightly with API gateway accept_queue growth. CPU profile shows prefetch workers doing long synchronous IO during kvcache fetch on cold keys.
Hedged retry policy amplified load: gateway sent duplicate requests when upstream latency crossed hedged threshold, increasing concurrency into already-congested runtimes.

Hypothesis: a particular key distribution for the tenant leads to frequent cold-prefetch across a small set of KV shards causing lock hotspots. Under burst, backpressure loops into hedged retries and watchdog restarts.
comments: Support (Aisha Patel) - 2026-03-12: Customer reported 15-20% error increase starting ~20:58 UTC. Collecting logs and route-level metrics per runbook.

SRE (Marco Ruiz) - 2026-03-12: Confirmed accept_queue climb and multiple runtime watchdog restarts. Temporarily increased API gateway hedged-retry threshold for the tenant as a mitigation (reduced duplicate load).
Eng (Lena Cho) - 2026-03-13: Reproduced lock hotspot locally when replaying tenant request key pattern. Adding exponential backoff to prefetch lock acquisition as a candidate fix.
Support (Aisha Patel) - 2026-03-13: Customer notified of temporary hedged-retry threshold increase and asked to pause heavy batch jobs. They agreed to throttle custom load for 1 hour.
SRE (Marco Ruiz) - 2026-03-14: Deployed runtime backoff patch to canary pool for affected dedicated hosts (PR linked). Monitoring for error rate reduction.
resolution_notes: Workaround applied: increased hedged-retry threshold in API gateway for NovaChat and paused aggressive background uploads per customer request. This immediately reduced duplicate fanout and lowered 5xx rate.
Temporary mitigation: throttled prefetch concurrency for the tenant and enabled a short lock-acquisition backoff in the runtime (canary rollout).

Fix planned: implement exponential backoff with jitter for prefetch lock acquisition and add kvcache hot-key backpressure metric to triggering autopolicy to shed prefetch for hot shards. PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/4821

Post-incident follow-up: add a dashboard and an automated runbook step to increase hedged-retry thresholds per-tenant when kvcache lock contention is detected. Schedule: engineer-led rollout next week and customer postmortem with NovaChat.
